football_evidence.question: Can North Carolina contain Miami’s explosive runs?
football_evidence.assessment: Some measured evidence supports EdgeDesk’s lean toward Miami, and its own breakdown accounts for about 0.0 of the 3.1 points, but not the full gap. It is a research question, not a bet.

When Miami has the ball (third down): Miami’s offense converts 58.4% of its third downs, and North Carolina’s defense allows opponents to convert 42.6% of their third downs (FBS average 39.5%).
